title: unified-rollouts: add preflight tests and stability guards for shadow/canary auto-rollback
author: Maya Patel
description:
Motivation: we observed two incidents in Q1 where a new model variant rolled out to canary+shadow traffic and triggered a noisy metric signal that caused an unnecessary rollback loop. This PR adds preflight/e2e checks, quarantine gates, and additional observability around auto-rollback decisions to reduce false positives while keeping automated safety.

What this PR does (summary):
- Adds a preflight test harness that runs a small suite of traffic profiles against candidate model variants before allowing canary routing.
- Introduces a quarantine stage that holds a canary in a probing state for a configurable window before metrics drive auto-rollback.
- Adds composite-metric evaluation (latency P95 + correctness regression on golden prompts + error-rate) with quorum-based thresholds to reduce sensitivity to single noisy signals.
- Emits new debug/trace spans and rollout decision events to make rollback reasons queryable in Console and alerting pipelines.
- Adds end-to-end tests simulating shadow + canary traffic and an integration test that validates no flapping for transient latency spikes.

Checklist:
- [x] Design doc linked (ENG-3456)
- [x] Unit tests for decision logic
- [x] e2e preflight + canary stability tests
- [x] Observability metrics and tracing
- [x] Docs/console changelog

Risk and fallback: changes are behind a feature flag rollout.quarantine.enabled and default to off for existing tenants. If any issues are seen we can toggle the flag and the new decision engine is namespaced to the rollout instance so it will not affect other controllers.

Notes for reviewers: focus on the composite metric aggregation and the timeout/quarantine semantics. The preflight harness is intentionally conservative and runs lightweight synthetic prompt sets. Related: ENG-3480 (observability for rollback reasons) and SUP-1221 (customer incident root cause).

review_comments: Arun Gupta: Overall looks good. Can you explain why we chose quorum=3 for composite metrics and how that interacts with tenants that have sparse traffic?

Maya Patel: Quorum=3 balances noise reduction and speed. For low-traffic tenants the preflight can be used (and the feature flag can force longer quarantine), we also default quorum to 1 for canaries with <100 requests/min as a safety net.
Leah Kim: Please add a unit test for the case where latency spikes but correctness is stable; we should not rollback immediately.
Maya Patel: Added unit test 'TestNoRollbackOnTransientLatency' in decision_engine_test.go and an e2e scenario that replays the transient spike for 30s.
Carlos Mendez: CI is flaky on e2e in the first run (integration/test timed out). Are we able to reduce the e2e time or move to a separate nightly?
Maya Patel: Reworked the e2e to be deterministic (mocked latency injection) and split the heaviest scenario to a slow-e2e workflow; CI now passes.
ci_checks: e2e-rollouts: pass (flaky scenario isolated to slow-e2e)
release_notes:
- Add preflight harness and quarantine stage to rollout engine to reduce false-positive autorollbacks.
- Composite metric aggregation for rollback decisions (latency P95, correctness delta, error-rate) with quorum thresholds.
- Emit structured rollback_reason events for observability and Console debugging.
- New e2e tests for shadow+canary stability to prevent rollout flapping.
notes: Feature gated: rollout.quarantine.enabled=false by default. Ops will enable for Dedicated customers in staged rollout. Console will show 'quarantine' phase in rollout timeline once enabled.
